core_obligations: Fix an open U and form the square with F(U), G(U) mapping to the products of their stalks (proof lines 1649-1656). The top horizontal arrow is a morphism of algebraic structures since the stalk maps are, the right vertical arrow is componentwise a morphism by assumption, and the bottom horizontal arrow is injective by the stalk-separation lemma (proof lines 1656-1659). All arrows except the left vertical one are morphisms of algebraic structures; the image of F(U) in the product of F-stalks maps into the image of G(U) because the square commutes, so the image-containment lemma factors the left vertical arrow through G(U) compatibly with the algebraic structure (proof lines 1660-1663). As U was arbitrary, phi is a morphism of sheaves of algebraic structures (proof lines 1648-1665).
proof_roadmap: Form the stalk square and identify which arrows are morphisms of algebraic structures (proof lines 1649-1659).
Apply the image-containment lemma to factor the left vertical arrow over each U (proof lines 1660-1665).
